dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Distinct irregular light-grey closed-loop and C-shaped structures with sharp outer perimeters transitioning from a dark-brown base. Most prominent rings show a medium-grey internal gradient interior to the light boundary.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Moderate density of small, solid light-toned pixel speckles and micro-clusters lack internal gradients, primarily situated in the interstitial spaces between larger macro-annuli in the mid-dorsal region.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: Centroids of three primary mid-dorsal rings form a prominent scalene triangle, while a secondary cluster of four smaller annuli in the posterior-dorsal region forms an irregular quadrilateral.
